title: SALES EXECUTIVE
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION – SALES EXECUTIVE**  
**Company:** AM Automation Solutions Pvt Ltd  
**Industry:** Garment Industrial Machinery & Automation Solutions  
**Location:** Tirupur, Tamil Nadu

About the Company

AM Automation Solutions Pvt Ltd is a leading provider of advanced garment industrial machinery and automation solutions. The company partners with global manufacturers to deliver modern technology and efficient industrial solutions for the garment industry.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for enthusiastic and energetic Sales Executives to join our growing team. Freshers and candidates with up to 1 year of experience are welcome to apply. The candidate will be responsible for promoting industrial machinery solutions, developing customer relationships, and supporting business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in the garment and textile industry.
* Promote and explain company products and automation solutions to customers.
* Meet clients directly and understand their machinery requirements.
* Generate leads through field visits, references, and follow-ups.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing customers.
* Coordinate with internal technical and sales teams for quotations and customer support.
* Prepare daily visit reports and sales updates.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Any Degree / Diploma (Mechanical, Textile, Business, or related field preferred).
* Freshers or candidates with 0–1 year experience in sales are eligible.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Basic computer knowledge (MS Office, Email, etc.).
* Willingness to travel for client meetings if required.

**Preferred Skills**

* Strong convincing and negotiation skills.
* Positive attitude and eagerness to learn.
* Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
* Interest in industrial machinery and automation products.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary based on performance.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Training and product knowledge support.
* Exposure to advanced garment industry technologies.
* Professional and supportive work environment.

**Contact**: 9944122380

**E-Mail**:hr@alppsmerkh.com

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Sales Manager – Apparel Automation & Machinery
description:
**Company Name:** AM Automation Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**About AM Automation Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**

AM Automation Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a provider of apparel automation and machinery solutions, offering a broad range of high-quality equipment to meet the evolving needs of the apparel industry. With a focus on precision, efficiency, innovation and customer satisfaction, the company supports customers through machinery procurement, installation, training and after-sales service.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a dynamic and target-oriented **Sales Manager** to drive sales growth, develop new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships in the apparel automation and machinery sector. The ideal candidate should have experience in B2B sales, customer acquisition, market development and sales target achievement, preferably in industrial machinery, textile machinery or apparel automation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Identify and acquire new customers, including garment manufacturers, apparel exporters, knitting units and textile factories.
* Generate leads through market visits, networking, customer references and other business development activities.
* Promote and sell apparel automation machinery, equipment and related solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and prospective clients.
* Conduct customer visits, product presentations and machinery demonstrations.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable machinery and automation solutions.
* Handle enquiries, prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms and close sales orders.
* Develop new markets, expand the customer base and identify opportunities for repeat business.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, customer demands and new business opportunities.
* Coordinate with the Technical, Service and Installation teams to ensure smooth execution of customer orders.
* Monitor sales pipelines, follow up on pending quotations and support timely payment collection.
* Prepare sales forecasts, customer visit reports and periodic sales performance reports.
* Lead, guide and monitor sales team members to achieve individual and overall sales targets, as applicable.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Business Administration, Marketing, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in sales, business development or B2B sales.
* Experience in industrial machinery, apparel machinery, textile machinery or automation is preferred.
* Proven ability to generate leads, acquire customers, negotiate and close sales.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and interpersonal skills.
* Good customer relationship management and market development capabilities.
* Ability to work independently, achieve targets and manage customer accounts.
* Willingness to travel regularly for customer visits and business development.
* Two-wheeler and valid driving licence required for customer visits.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Performance-based incentives, subject to company policy.
* Opportunity to contribute to business expansion in the apparel automation industry.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Tirupur North, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Jewellery Sales Executive
description:
Jewellery Sales Executive – Gold Jewellery | Tirupur Location

Employment Type

Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for an Jewellery Sales Executive with any retail Field . The ideal candidate should have excellent customer handling skills, a passion for jewellery sales, and the ability to convert walk-in customers into loyal clients.

Key Responsibilities

* Welcome and assist customers professionally.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable gold, diamond jewellery.
* Deliver an outstanding luxury shopping experience.
* Achieve monthly and yearly sales targets.
* Build long-term customer relationships and encourage repeat purchases.
* Handle billing coordination, order bookings, advance bookings, and customer follow-ups.
* Explain jewellery purity, BIS Hallmark, making charges, wastage, exchange, and buyback policies.
* Cross-sell matching jewellery collections and value-added products.
* Maintain showroom display standards and product presentation.
* Coordinate with inventory, cashier, and store operations.
* Handle customer concerns professionally and ensure complete customer satisfaction.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum 0-3 years of jewellery showroom sales experience.
* Excellent communication skills in Tamil.
* English communication is an added advantage.
* Strong sales closing and customer relationship skills.
* Positive attitude with a professional appearance.
* Passion for achieving sales targets.
* Ability to work on weekends and festival seasons.
* Immediate joiners are preferred.

If any Doubt pls Contact : 9840562415 & 96553 51515

Pay: ₹16,500.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month
